scene: The booster ramp catapults you into the Grand Transit interchange.
picture: A flat side view of the wide aerial dock. On the far left, a gleaming solar junk floats moored to a post. Left of centre stands the player on her white roller skates. Centre-right, a yellow weather balloon basket is tied to the railing. On the far right waits the open door of a maglev dragon train.
